title: Questions raised over US vetting of Nvidia chip sales to China
excerpt: Concerns emerge regarding the Commerce Department and Nvidia's vetting process after an approved Chinese firm's office was found empty.
body_html:
Questions are being raised regarding the vetting processes used by both the US Commerce Department and Nvidia for Chinese firms authorized to handle advanced AI chips.

According to reports, a company named New Matrix appeared on the list of approved firms cleared to receive Nvidia's H200 AI chips. However, an inspection of the company's designated location revealed an empty office described as a hollow gray shell.

The situation highlights potential gaps in due diligence surrounding the export and distribution of restricted technology to foreign markets.
